comparison.objective: Brace a dolly while pushing a wide case onto a marked spot.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand stabilizes a movable support while the other performs non-prehensile pushing.
comparison.success_condition: Case is upright and off the dolly in the zone, with dolly displacement limited.
comparison.reason: Although it uses reaction bracing, it does not adjust and lock a threaded stop or test retained function.
